items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: we played for a doctor... Dr. Matthew

ctx.x: With Baby sitting there on the, uh, on the platform at lunchtime or something. Yeah. With his old clothes on, you know, working there and then just resting there.
Yeah, we used to play in a different place. Um, we played for a doctor, you know, in, uh, let me see a, not Bunky, not Bunky. Oh, shit. Let me see where Dr. Matthew was.
Yeah. In some town around here.
